rows.text: CDL pledged net zero operational carbon by 2030 for new and existing wholly-owned assets and developments under direct operational and management control.
rows.source_sentence: By joining the Commitment, we pledged net zero operational carbon by 2030 for our new and existing wholly-owned assets and developments under our direct operational and management control.

rows.text: CDL maintained 100% retail and office tenant participation in Green Lease Partnership Programme.
rows.source_sentence: Achieve 100% 100% maintained

rows.text: CDL reduced carbon emissions intensity by 43% from 2007 levels.
rows.source_sentence: 42% reduction 43% reduction

rows.text: CDL's Integrated Sustainability Report 2021 harmonizes multiple international reporting frameworks including GRI, IIRC, SDG, TCFD, and SASB.
rows.source_sentence: These include the Global Reporting Initiative (GRI) Standards as its core (since 2008); International Integrated Reporting Council’s (IIRC) Integrated Reporting Framework (since 2015); SDG Reporting (since 2016); Task Force on Climate-related Financial Disclosures (TCFD) framework (since 2017) and Sustainability Accounting Standards Board (SASB) (since 2020).

rows.text: CDL is dedicated to achieving net zero operational carbon by 2030 for new and existing wholly-owned assets and developments under direct operational and management control.
rows.source_sentence: By joining the Commitment, CDL is dedicated to achieving net zero operational carbon by 2030 for our new and existing wholly-owned assets and developments under our direct operational and management control.

rows.text: CDL pledges to disclose, reduce, and verify operating Scope 1 and 2 emissions of managed buildings, including the corporate office in Singapore.
rows.source_sentence: Pledging to the WorldGBC’s Net Zero Carbon Buildings Commitment will entail CDL disclosing, reducing and verifying operating Scope 1 and 2 emissions of our managed buildings, including our corporate office in Singapore.

rows.text: CDL will strive to reduce carbon emissions by retrofitting managed buildings to enhance energy efficiency and accelerating the transition to renewable energy.
rows.source_sentence: To achieve this ambitious goal, CDL will strive to reduce our carbon emissions, including retrofitting our managed buildings to further enhance energy efficiency and accelerating the transition to renewable energy.

rows.text: CDL has mapped out pathways to achieve net zero carbon in operation by 2030, including leveraging smart technologies and emerging innovations to maximize buildings’ energy performance.
rows.source_sentence: The company has also mapped out pathways to achieve net zero carbon in operation by 2030 through: • Leveraging smart technologies and emerging innovations to maximise buildings’ energy performance.

rows.text: CDL aims to achieve 100% renewable energy as part of its net zero carbon pathways.
rows.source_sentence: • Achieving 100% renewable energy.

rows.text: CDL plans to develop a low-carbon investment roadmap to achieve net zero carbon in operation by 2030.
rows.source_sentence: • Developing a low-carbon investment roadmap.

rows.text: CDL is committed to phasing out diesel across all operations as part of its net zero carbon pathways.
rows.source_sentence: • Phasing out diesel across all operations.

rows.text: CDL will strengthen supply chain engagement to lower the embodied carbon of its developments.
rows.source_sentence: • Strengthening supply chain engagement to lower the embodied carbon of our developments.

rows.text: CDL developed the Smart, Sustainable and Super Low Energy (3S) Green Building Framework, aligned with BCA Super Low Energy (SLE) buildings requirements and international standards.
rows.source_sentence: To complement CDL’s target to achieve net zero for our buildings by 2030, CDL further developed a Smart, Sustainable and Super Low Energy (3S) Green Building Framework, known as the 3S Green Building Framework. An expansion of CDL’s green procurement guidelines, this holistic framework is aligned with BCA Super Low Energy (SLE) buildings requirements, as well as international standards for advancing health and wellbeing in buildings.

rows.text: CDL has implemented various initiatives to enhance energy and water efficiency at Republic Plaza, including retrofitting chiller plants and installing energy-efficient lighting with motion sensors.
rows.source_sentence: Various initiatives to enhance energy and water efficiency have been implemented at Republic Plaza, including the major retrofitting of chiller plants and the installation of energy-efficient lightings with motion sensors.

rows.text: CDL plans to explore carbon emissions reduction solutions in building design and materials, including innovative carbon-negative building materials.
rows.source_sentence: As the company enhances diversification of raw materials and source countries to minimise future supply chain risks, we will also continue to explore carbon emissions reduction solutions in building design and materials, such as the usage of innovative carbon-negative building materials.

rows.text: CDL continues to maintain high standards in green building through the use of sustainable materials and the implementation of a vertical garden.
rows.source_sentence: CDL continues to maintain high standards in green building through the use of sustainable materials and the implementation of a vertical garden.

rows.text: The deck is made from 95% recycled materials comprising 65% reclaimed Forest Stewardship Council certified wood and 30% polyethylene, and has been awarded the highest-tiered certification by the Singapore Green Building Council.
rows.source_sentence: Made from 95% recycled materials comprising 65% reclaimed Forest Stewardship Council—which provides certification of timber products that originate from forests that are managed responsibly and sustainably— certified wood and 30% polyethylene, the deck is highly durable, safe, and has a low environmental impact. It has been awarded the highest-tiered certification by the Singapore Green Building Council.

rows.text: The NUS-CDL Smart Green Home is a unique indoor test-bed environment that serves as a platform for holistic and innovative experimental studies on smart features, green building technologies and design for sustainable living.
rows.source_sentence: The NUS-CDL Smart Green Home is a unique indoor test-bed environment that serves as a platform for holistic and innovative experimental studies on smart features, green building technologies and design for sustainable living.

rows.text: To commemorate World Water Day, the CDL Sustainability Department put together a short quiz for our staff on valuing water.
rows.source_sentence: To commemorate World Water Day, the CDL Sustainability Department put together a short quiz for our staff on valuing water.

rows.text: Pledging our commitment towards water sustainability and to rally the nation to use water wisely, we lit up Republic Plaza’s crown in blue.
rows.source_sentence: Pledging our commitment towards water sustainability and to rally the nation to use water wisely, we lit up Republic Plaza’s crown in blue.

rows.text: Given CDL's strong governance focus in sustainability reporting and sector leadership, the company likely maintains robust business ethics through board independence, clear anti-corruption policies, and alignment with global ESG standards.
